title: News, society and community life
context:
**In this topic** you talk about short news texts and about community life in Portugal. You learn words for parts of a news item (*notícia, título, artigo, gráfico, entrevista*) and for social life (*comunidade, vizinhos, associação, voluntariado*). You also practise two very common patterns in simple news Portuguese: **Segundo a notícia...** (*According to the news item...*) and **O número de ... aumentou / diminuiu** (*The number of ... increased / decreased*).

Examples:
- **Leio o título primeiro.** — *I read the headline first.*
- **Este artigo fala de integração.** — *This article talks about integration.*
- **Há um gráfico no jornal.** — *There is a graph in the newspaper.*
- **Os vizinhos participam na associação do bairro.** — *The neighbours take part in the neighbourhood association.*
- **Faço voluntariado ao sábado.** — *I do voluntary work on Saturdays.*
- **Segundo a notícia, o número de voluntários aumentou.** — *According to the news item, the number of volunteers increased.*

Watch out:
- After **o número de**, the verb is usually singular: **o número de alunos aumentou**.
- **Direitos e deveres** is a fixed chunk: learn it together as “rights and duties”.

exercises.prompt: Choose the Portuguese for the word in bold.
exercises.explanation: In news vocabulary, «título» is the headline or title of the text, not the whole article.

exercises.prompt: Choose the Portuguese for the word in bold.
exercises.explanation: «Jornal» is the newspaper or news publication. An «entrevista» is just one kind of text inside it.
exercises.sentence: The local **newspaper** has an interview with the association.

exercises.prompt: Choose the Portuguese for the word in bold.
exercises.explanation: For a past change in a short news sentence, «aumentou» means «increased». «Diminuiu» means «decreased».
exercises.sentence: The number of volunteers **increased** this year.

exercises.prompt: Match each Portuguese word with its meaning.
exercises.explanation: These are basic words for reading simple news texts.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "According to the news item, the number of volunteers increased."
exercises.explanation: After «Segundo a», you name the source. With «o número de», the verb normally stays singular: «aumentou».
exercises.template: Segundo a ___, o número de voluntários ___.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence about community life.
exercises.explanation: «Vizinhos» is plural, and «associação» is a common word for a local group in the neighbourhood.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence about integration.
exercises.explanation: Two common chunks are «aprender a língua» and «ajuda na integração».
exercises.template: Aprender a ___ ajuda na ___ e no trabalho.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence about challenges for migrants.
exercises.explanation: At this level, learn these as useful real-life chunks: «encontrar casa» and «reconhecer diplomas».
exercises.template: Encontrar ___ e reconhecer ___ podem ser desafios.

exercises.prompt: Say: This article talks about integration in Portugal.
exercises.explanation: Use «falar de» for the topic of a text: «O artigo fala de...».
acceptedAnswers: Este artigo fala sobre integração em Portugal.
Este artigo fala da integração em Portugal.
Este artigo fala sobre a integração em Portugal.

exercises.prompt: Say: According to the news item, the number of volunteers decreased.
exercises.explanation: «Segundo a notícia» means «according to the news item». After «o número de», the verb is singular: «diminuiu».

exercises.prompt: Say: The association helps migrants to learn the language.
exercises.explanation: After «ajudar», Portuguese often uses «a + infinitive»: «ajuda ... a aprender».

exercises.prompt: Say: Our neighbours do voluntary work in the community.
exercises.explanation: In European Portuguese, possessives before a noun take the article: «os nossos vizinhos». «Na» is «em + a».

exercises.prompt: Say: Rights and duties are important in society.
exercises.explanation: «Direitos e deveres» is a fixed pair. Because the subject is plural, the verb is «são».
acceptedAnswers: Os direitos e os deveres são importantes na sociedade.

exercises.prompt: You are looking at a text with a friend. Ask (informal): “Is it an article or an interview?”
exercises.explanation: To offer two options, Portuguese uses «ou». Here you only need the two text types.
acceptedAnswers: Isto é um artigo ou uma entrevista?

exercises.prompt: Your classmate answers: «Segundo a notícia, aumentou.» Ask: “What happened to the number of volunteers?”
exercises.explanation: To ask about a change, use «O que aconteceu ao ...?». «Ao» is the contraction of «a + o».
acceptedAnswers: O que é que aconteceu ao número de voluntários?

exercises.prompt: A teacher gives this answer: «Porque querem ajudar a comunidade.» Ask: “Why do the neighbours do voluntary work?”
exercises.explanation: For a reason, ask with «Porque é que ...?». This is a very common spoken pattern.

exercises.prompt: At work, your colleague answers: «Fala dos desafios dos migrantes.» Ask: “What does the article talk about?”
exercises.explanation: With «falar de», ask with «De que ...?». The very common spoken form is «De que é que fala ...?».
acceptedAnswers: De que é que o artigo fala?

exercises.prompt: One word is wrong. Tap it and choose the correction.
exercises.explanation: The subject «os nossos vizinhos» is plural, so the verb must also be plural: «participam».

exercises.prompt: One word is wrong. Tap it and choose the correction.
exercises.explanation: «Notícia» is feminine, so the article is «a»: «segundo a notícia».

exercises.prompt: Answer about yourself.
exercises.explanation: Use a short real answer about your life. You can say yes and give an example, or say no.
exercises.question: Participas em atividades da tua comunidade?
exercises.sampleAnswer: Sim, ajudo numa associação do bairro.

exercises.prompt: Choose the Portuguese for the word in bold.
exercises.explanation: In news texts, «gráfico» means a graph or chart. It is a masculine noun: «um gráfico».
exercises.sentence: There is a **graph** in the article about housing.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "According to the news item, the number of foreign students decreased this year."
exercises.explanation: Use the fixed phrase «Segundo a notícia». After «o número de», the verb is usually singular: «diminuiu».
exercises.template: Segundo a ___, o número de alunos estrangeiros ___ este ano.

exercises.prompt: Say: Raj reads an article about migrants' challenges.
exercises.explanation: Use «ler um artigo sobre ...». With the plural noun, Portuguese normally uses the article: «os desafios dos migrantes».
acceptedAnswers: Raj lê um artigo sobre os desafios dos migrantes.

exercises.prompt: Your friend answers: «Leio o jornal ao pequeno-almoço.» Ask him (informal) what he reads at breakfast.
exercises.explanation: To ask for the thing someone reads, use «O que». In European Portuguese, «é que» is also very common.
acceptedAnswers: O que é que lês ao pequeno-almoço?

exercises.prompt: One word is wrong. Tap it and choose the correction.
exercises.explanation: After «o número de ...», the verb is usually singular. So we say «o número de pessoas aumentou».

exercises.prompt: Say: Li does voluntary work with the neighbours on Saturdays.
exercises.explanation: Use the chunk «fazer voluntariado». «Ao sábado» is a common European Portuguese way to talk about Saturdays in general.
acceptedAnswers: Li faz voluntariado com os vizinhos ao sábado.
A Li faz voluntariado com os vizinhos aos sábados.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "In the newspaper there is a graph and an interview about the community."
exercises.explanation: «Gráfico» goes with the masculine article «um», and «entrevista» goes with the feminine article «uma».
exercises.template: No jornal, há um ___ e uma ___ sobre a comunidade.

exercises.prompt: Your neighbour answers: «Na associação do bairro.» Ask him (informal) where the neighbours do voluntary work.
exercises.explanation: Use «Onde» to ask about place. In European Portuguese, the question can be «Onde é que ...?»

exercises.prompt: Choose the Portuguese for the words in bold.
exercises.explanation: «Os direitos e deveres» is a fixed chunk. Learn it together for everyday life, work and public services.
exercises.sentence: It is important to know your **rights and duties** in Portugal.

exercises.prompt: Answer about yourself.
exercises.explanation: You can answer with a short frequency expression plus an activity, for example about helping locally or not helping yet.
exercises.question: Fazes voluntariado na tua comunidade?
